en.headline: CFS detects excess doxycycline in imported frozen chicken legs
en.dek: A sample of the Cheng brand product from China contained 180 parts per billion, above the 100 ppb legal limit; the importer has begun a recall.
body: The Centre for Food Safety said on Friday that a sample of imported frozen chicken legs tested under its routine surveillance programme contained doxycycline at 180 parts per billion, exceeding the legal limit of 100 ppb.

The product is the Cheng brand bone-in chicken legs, 240-260 grams, originating from China and imported by Willy More Development Limited. Cartons weigh 15 kilograms, with a manufacture date of 22 July 2026 and a best-before date of 21 January 2028.

The centre has instructed the importer to stop sale and remove the affected batch; a recall is under way. Members of the public should not consume the product, and the trade should not use or sell it. The hotline for enquiries is 2944 8139 during office hours. The centre said the detected level is unlikely to cause adverse health effects under normal consumption. Under the Harmful Substances in Food Regulations, offenders face a fine of HK$50,000 and six months’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 食安中心檢出進口冷藏雞腿強力霉素超標
zh.dek: 中國進口「城字」牌雞帶骨全腿樣本含量達每公斤180十億分，高於法例上限100十億分；進口商已展開回收。
body: 食物安全中心周五公布，恆常食物監測計劃下的一個進口冷藏雞腿樣本檢出強力霉素含量每公斤180十億分，超過法例上限每公斤100十億分。
涉事產品為「城字」牌雞帶骨全腿240至260克，來源地中國，進口商為維利加發展有限公司。每箱淨重15公斤，生產日期為2026年7月22日，此日期前最佳為2028年1月21日。
中心已指令進口商停售及下架受影響批次，回收正進行中。市民應停止食用，業界亦不應使用或出售。查詢熱線2944 8139（辦公時間）。中心表示按檢出含量，正常食用下不會對健康造成不良影響。根據《食物內有害物質規例》，違例者可被罰款5萬元及監禁六個月。
